finding: Audit-only HTMLParser left an unclosed selected child (e.g. p) on the stack when its selected parent (li or td) closed, merging subsequent siblings into one block and distorting cross-page coverage metrics.

sourcePages.evidence: Echo priority lists and nested explanations
Shield Block uptime, Ignore Pain and resource management
Q&A about DoTs, M+ and Soul Shards

fix.behavior: Unwind selected descendants when a matching selected ancestor closes; emit only outermost semantic block

limitations: Wowhead live HTML structure cannot be verified from indexed excerpts; no claim that malformed markup occurs on sampled pages
Source-only extractor is not the Chrome DOM reconstruction engine
Translator API and French output require browser-only verification
